reference_note: THE STIMULUS CARRIES A REAL TIE AT HIGH LANES: 40017 and 48000 both hold the row's maximum, so `ref_out.bin`'s single lane is 40017 -- FIRST-max pinned against a tie, not a vacuous uniqueness. THE NEGATIVE CONTROLS ARE PART OF THE CONTRACT, AND THERE ARE TWO: (1) a last-max implementation answers 48000 against these same bytes and must not match `ref_out.bin`; a run that still matches cannot have taken the tie. (2) an f16-DEGRADED FINAL COMBINE answers 40032 or 40016 -- 40017 = 625*64 + 17 is not fp16-representable (ULP 32 at [32768, 65536)) -- so a kernel whose `b*64 + l` island collapsed out of f32 cannot match either; a run that still matches cannot have degraded. The tie lanes are high ON PURPOSE: the original 100/5000 stimulus sat inside fp16's exact-integer range and could not see (2) at all. The pad lanes past V=49155 hold -inf in the row and NB/BLOCK in the increasing tables (the host obligations the fixture's own docstring states); a kernel that lets a pad lane win the equality answers PAD_V-adjacent garbage, never 40017.
